analyst.summary: Paras Defence continues to grow rapidly (54% revenue growth, doubling of profit in the latest quarter) on the strength of niche, hard-to-replicate defence and space technology positions, in a sector benefiting from India's push to build defence equipment domestically. The company has just announced a very large new commitment -- a Rs.6,200 crore semiconductor assembly-and-test facility -- that is bigger than the company's entire current market value and a significant departure from its core defence business; how this gets funded (equity dilution vs. new debt) is likely to matter as much to shareholders as the underlying defence growth story itself.
